items.title: Jusuf Nurkic had 20 points (12-for-12 FTs) as Bosnia fell to Lithuania today.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Jusuf Nurkic had 20 points (12-for-12 FTs) as Bosnia fell to Lithuania today.

Luka Garza finished with 14 points and 7 rebounds.

items.title: Bosnia squeaked by Italy today, led by Jusuf Nurkic: 25 points, 14 rebounds.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Bosnia squeaked by Italy today, led by Jusuf Nurkic: 25 points, 14 rebounds.

Luka Garza had 10 points and 7 rebounds for Bosnia.

Simone Fontecchio led Italy with 14 points and 6 rebounds.

Cavs 2025 draftee Saliou Niang had a strong game with 8 points and some good defense for Italy.
